findings.title: New DashboardEmptyState wrapper has no unit tests
findings.detail: The polish introduces a local DashboardEmptyState helper that composes the shared EmptyState with a Link-backed Button. All six call sites pass through it, but there are no tests verifying it renders the icon, title, and correct href.
findings.fix_suggestion: Add a small test file next to the dashboard or in __tests__ that renders DashboardEmptyState and asserts the CTA link href.

findings.title: No tests assert Link-wrapped KPI cards route to the right pages
findings.detail: KPI cards are now wrapped in next/link with hardcoded routes (/deals, /invoices). There is no component or e2e test verifying those hrefs, so a future refactor could break navigation silently.
findings.fix_suggestion: Add a minimal component test (with Convex queries mocked) that checks each KPI card contains a link with the expected href.

findings.title: No regression test for invalid activity timestamps
findings.detail: The adversarial review identified that malformed createdAt/dueAt values can crash the dashboard via Intl formatters. A test should exercise the safe fallback now added to format-date.ts.
findings.fix_suggestion: Add a unit test in src/__tests__/format-date.test.ts that asserts formatDistanceToNow(NaN) and format(NaN, 'MMM d, yyyy') return '—' rather than throwing.

residual_risks.summary: Existing convex/__tests__/dashboardStructure.test.ts still references agingDeals shape even though the dashboard page no longer renders it. If the field is later removed from the backend query, the frontend and backend tests could drift.

testing_gaps.summary: No component or e2e test covers the polished dashboard layout (KPI grid, charts, tables, activities).
No test verifies the loading skeleton is shown until all dependent queries (including comparisonLoading, analyticsOverview, agingLoading, productsLoading) have resolved.
